PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Title: {quickhack} Effect
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.DamagedEarMissin: CPR's native Damaged Ear Critical Injury could not be found.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.sonic-shock: The native Damaged Ear Critical Injury was added to {target}, without bonus damage. Remove it manually when Sonic Shock ends.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.synapse-burnout: {target} takes {damage} damage directly to HP. Armor is ignored and not ablated.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.system-reset: Native system statuses applied to {target}: {statuses}. Remove them manually when System Reset ends or the target awakens.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Guidance.short-c: GM: choose three eligible pieces of {target}'s cyberware. They cease functioning for 60 seconds (20 rounds).
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Guidance.impair-: Lower {target}'s MOVE by 1 for 60 seconds (20 rounds), then restore it manually. No actor data was changed.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Guidance.overhea: {target} is on fire and should take 4 damage directly to HP at the end of each turn until extinguished. No status or ongoing damage was applied because Cyberpunk RED does not register a native On Fire status.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Guidance.cyberwa: Netrunner: choose one eligible piece of {target}'s cyberware. It and its attached options cease functioning for 60 seconds (20 rounds).
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Guidance.lure: At the start of {target}'s next turn, control their Move Action toward the phantom noise. Do not reveal this message to the target.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Guidance.puppet: Netrunner: control {target}'s Action and Move Action during their next turn, using the target's STATs and Skills.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Guidance.slow: The Slow penalty is {amount}. Lower {target}'s MOVE by that amount for 60 seconds (20 rounds), then restore it manually. No actor data was changed.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Guidance.shard-e: Netrunner: choose one installed piece of {target}'s chipware. Uninstall it and place it in an adjacent square unless the slot is covered.
PNEUMA_QUICKHACK.Effect.Guidance.system-: Apply Unconscious and Prone to {target} for 60 seconds (20 rounds), with Unconscious ending early if they take damage. No status was applied because Cyberpunk RED does not register either status natively.
